subject: NextWave LLM pilot — pausing demo due to roadmap changes
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nextwave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync + demo for your LLM inference questions

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Per our conversation, I put together a short demo focused on:
- cold-start latency with batch sizing
- KV cache behavior across sessions
- cost/latency tradeoffs for 8-bit quantized variants

Would you and Ethan be available for a 45-minute walkthrough the week of May 24? I can bring Marcus (solutions engineer) to show the live run and the MVP demo deck attached.

Proposed slots: Tue 5/25 10am PT, Wed 5/26 2pm PT, Thu 5/27 11am PT. Tell me what works or share a few times and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachment: MVP-demo-deck.pdf (slide highlights + rough cost estimates)

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nextwave.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@nextwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync + demo for your LLM inference questions

Hi Lukas —

Appreciate the follow-up and the deck. Ethan and I reviewed — useful level of detail. Unfortunately we just kicked off a sprint re-prioritization and resources on the LLM project are being pulled into a payment platform migration. That means we need to pause any new vendor demos related to inference for the next 6–8 weeks.

Could we pause the demo for now and pick this back up after June 30? If anything changes sooner I’ll reach out.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Head of AI Partnerships | NextWave Health
alyssa@nextwave.ai

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NextWave pause — need plan

Folks — forwarding Alyssa’s note. NextWave just reallocated the LLM work to a payments migration and wants to pause demos for 6–8 weeks. Thoughts on the follow-up cadence and whether we should keep them in the waitlist / POC queue?

My take:
- Acknowledge and offer to keep a single 30-min “reconnect” slot after June 30.
- Send a condensed one-pager (1 page) summarizing the cost/latency benefits tailored to their use case so it’s easy to surface to their PM.
- Mark deal stage to "On Hold - customer priority" in HubSpot and set a reminder for 2027-07-05.

Marcus — can you draft a tight one-pager anchored to the deck (2–3 bullets + expected token-cost delta) so Alyssa can share it internally without another meeting? Monica — I’ll update HubSpot and flag for a follow-up.

— Lukas

--- Forwarded message ---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nextwave.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: NextWave pause — need plan

Lukas / Monica —

Thanks for the context. I put together a single-page executive note (summary + 3 charts) and attached it. It calls out:
- likely monthly token-cost delta (baseline vs 8-bit quantized) for their average query length,
- sample latency numbers for 1–4 concurrent users,
- a simple fallback plan if they need to delay rollout (pin an earlier model variant).

Attachment: MVP-demo-onepager.pdf (1 page)

Alyssa — I’m CC’ing you so you have the one-pager in your inbox. No need to respond — happy to jump on a short call if it’s helpful once you’re back on the project.

Plan for our side: Monica to set HubSpot stage to On Hold and set a follow-up task for 2027-07-06. Lukas, I’ll be ready with a demo slot the week of July 12 if they want a live run then.

— Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
